title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR
description:
A epharma é uma das principais plataformas de gestão de benefícios de medicamentos no Brasil, conectando tecnologia e saúde de forma inovadora desde 1999. Como pioneira na criação do PBM – Plano de Benefícios de Medicamentos no país, a epharma atua como um elo estratégico entre indústrias farmacêuticas, farmácias, startups, setor público e empresas privadas de diversos segmentos. Com uma rede de mais de 42 mil farmácias e 2 mil clínicas e laboratórios de diagnóstico credenciados, a epharma já beneficiou mais de 32.9 milhões de pessoas, gerando uma economia superior a R$ 2.5 bilhões em 2024.

Estamos contratando PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR para oxigenar as conexões e impulsionar a saúde com a gente!

Descrição :

Atuar na área de Tecnologia Informação, exercendo a liderança técnica da equipe; assegurando a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito; assegurando a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas; fiscalizando a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações; liderando tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo.


Responsabilidades :

  • Exercer a liderança técnica da equipe;
  • Assegurar a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito;
  • Assegurar a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas;
  • Fiscalizar a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI sobre os objetivos do projeto;
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados que possibilitem o processamento, integração e coleta de dados de diversas fontes;
  • Integrar novas tecnologias de gerenciamento de dados e ferramentas de engenharia de software nas estruturas existentes;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a análise de dados e criar visualizações e relatórios, de modo a auxiliar a empresa na tomada de decisões com base em dados;
  • Instalar e atualizar os procedimentos de recuperação de desastres;
  • Recomendar formas de melhorar a confiabilidade dos dados, eficiência e qualidade;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e tecnologias de Big Data, como Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive e outras
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e científica.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica ou atuação como Tech Lead, Data Engineering Lead, Machine Learning Lead ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação aplicadas a dados e alta performance: Python, Scala e Pyspark .
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados , arquitetura de dados , ETL/ELT e construção de pipelines.
  • Vivência com tecnologias de Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação , governança de dados e conformidade (incluindo LGPD).
  • Experiência com ambientes on-premise , cloud ou híbridos.


Formação acadêmica :

Formação em Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Horário de trabalho: de segunda-feira a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h, com uma hora de intervalor

Benefícios : Você decide o que é benefício para você! Oferecemos mais de 40 opções para você escolher e usar como quiser em nosso marketplace de benefícios.

Conheça todos os nosso benefícios incríveis:

Nossa cultura:

Nossa cultura é movida por ownership, resultado e inovação. Acreditamos que cada epharmer é protagonista de sua jornada e peça fundamental no alcance de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde o empoderamento, a colaboração e a busca constante por soluções inovadoras são os pilares do nosso crescimento. Somos uma organização dinâmica, que valoriza as conexões inteligentes e o impacto real que criamos na vida das pessoas.

Aqui, cada resultado é compartilhado e cada avanço é celebrado. Nossa missão é desafiar o status quo, oxigenar conexões e impulsionar a saúde em todas as dimensões. Com transparência e confiança, incentivamos cada colaborador a ir além, assumindo a responsabilidade por suas entregas e construindo, juntos, um legado de transformação.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA EPHARMA?

Fazemos mais do que conectar pessoas à saúde. Construímos experiências que inspiram. Somos uma empresa certificada como GPTW e nosso compromisso vai além dos números: queremos ser referência em pessoas e resultados, inovando continuamente. Se você é movido(a) por desafios, acredita no poder da inovação e busca resultados com propósito, aqui é o seu lugar.

Junte-se ao propósito de transformar a saúde com inovação e protagonismo. Vem ser um epharmer!

title: Chef Tournant

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team

  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency

  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces . We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • You’ll be working with many strategic leaders within the company.
  • The ETL Engineering team is growing rapidly.
  • You’ll be challenged with a lot of big data problems.


About The Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic ETL Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of software engineering experience and/or data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimize for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Additionally, ETL Engineering serves as the gold standard for all other YipitData analyst teams, building and maintaining the core pipelines that power our products. This high-impact, high-visibility team is instrumental to the success of our rapidly growing business. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced strategic team and help solve some of our biggest data challenges.


We expect US East Coast work hours:

  • Candidates should be available and willing to work during East Coast business hours (approximately 10/11am – 6/7pm EST).


As Our Data Engineer You Will:

  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using Pyspark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL toolings.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in other technical function.
  • You are excited about solving data challenges and learning new skills.
  • You have some understanding of working with data or building data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind data transformations to ensure alignment with organizational goals and data strategy.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working collaboratively with stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Start Date: Immediate

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: JavaScript Engineer — 3D Web Developer
description:

  • Asset Ingestion: Build robust logic to support the ingestion of GLB and FBX assets with embedded textures.


Essential Qualifications

  • Expert JavaScript/TypeScript: 5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern ES6+ syntax.


  • 3D Web Libraries: Extensive commercial experience with Three.js , React Three Fiber (R3F) , or Babylon.js.


  • Graphics Math & Geometry: Solid understanding of Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices) and Raycasting logic required for the \"Sticker\", “Material” and \"Painting\" tools.


  • Strong professional experience with Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication, Hosting, and Storage).


  • Understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and client–server communication.


  • Experience with version control systems (Git ) and collaborative development workflows.


  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.


  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


  • Excellent English verbal and written.



Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . 2. Testing & Quality

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Payroll Project Manager
description:
Location : Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Duration : 9 Months (Fixed-Term Contract), Starting Feb 2026

Reporting to: Director


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Payroll Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Client’s new payroll system and service model. You will serve as the primary bridge between Client’s internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, IT), local partner and Neeyamo implementation teams. Your mission is to ensure that the implementation is seamless, compliant with Brazilian labor laws (CLT), and delivered on time and within budget.


Key Responsibilities

 Project Leadership: Act as the single point of contact for the external payroll provider,

ensuring their delivery matches our business requirements and local statutory needs.

 Implementation Oversight: Manage the full implementation lifecycle: discovery, data

migration, parallel runs, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and \"Go-Live.\"

 Stakeholder Management: Facilitate weekly status meetings with internal leadership and the

provider’s project team to track progress and unblock issues.

 Data Migration & Quality: Lead the cleansing and mapping of legacy data into the new

provider’s platform, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee records and year-to-date balances.

 Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate workflows between HRIS and the

new payroll platform to reduce manual intervention.

 Risk Mitigation: Maintain a Risk & Issue Log, proactively identifying bottlenecks that could

delay the 10-month timeline.

 Planning : Compliance: Support future implementation planning, prepare Wave Plans, and

ensure adherence to project management frameworks


Qualifications & Skills

 Experience: 7+ years in Payroll implementations &; project management or HR Project

Management, with at least 2 successful large-scale payroll implementations.

 Local Expertise: Knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and the eSocial framework is

beneficial.

 Language : Fluency in Portuguese and English (required for global reporting).

 Technical Savvy : Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana) and

advanced Excel. Experience/ knowledge on any Ewaider& ;Co suite of products will be an

additional advantage.

 Communication: Strong negotiation skills to manage vendor performance and expectations.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI & Orchestration)
description:
Company Description


A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.


Mais informações: Coru Website


Job Description


Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)

  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.
  • Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.


4. Liderança e Mentoria

  • Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de \"Build vs buy\" relacionadas com componentes de IA;
  • Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);
  • Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
  • Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;
  • Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.


Competências Essenciais

  • Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico \"apenas de IA\";
  • Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;
  • Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.


Desejável/ Plus

  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);
  • Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.



Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

title: Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining ASP.NET Core web applications and data APIs that support real-time sports and event management platforms.
  • Implementing backend logic using C#, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ, ensuring clean, maintainable code.

  • Integrating with Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Azure AD as part of the platform ecosystem.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Criar e evoluir bibliotecas de componentes reutilizáveis e design systems compartilhados entre squads.

Implementar estratégias de deploy e entrega contínua focadas em performance e estabilidade.

Monitorar métricas de performance como LCP, FID e CLS, liderando iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

Aplicar boas práticas de monitoramento e observabilidade em aplicações frontend.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência com frameworks frontend modernos, com forte foco em Vue.js 3 e TypeScript.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida do Vue.js e de suas principais APIs (reatividade, composição, diretivas e otimização de renderização).
  • Experiência prática com: Composition API; script setup; Slots, Teleport, Provide/Inject ;Componentes dinâmicos
  • Conhecimento avançado em gerenciamento de estado com Pinia ou Vuex, aplicando estratégias escaláveis.
  • Vivência com lazy loading, code splitting e otimização de bundle usando Vite ou Webpack.
  • Experiência com SSR (Server Side Rendering) e SSG (Static Site Generation), especialmente com Nuxt.js.
  • Proficiência em HTML5, CSS3, pré-processadores (SASS) e frameworks utilitários (Tailwind CSS).
  • Experiência avançada com testes automatizados (Jest, Testing Library, Cypress).
  • Vivência sólida em componentização e manutenção de design systems.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de deploy frontend e otimização da entrega de aplicações.
  • Domínio de métricas de performance web e técnicas de otimização.
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST e GraphQL.
  • Uso avançado de Git e ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento prático em acessibilidade (a11y).
  • Atuação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em componentes.

title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description:
About the Role

We’re hiring high-performing B2B SaaS Account Executives based in LATAM who want full ownership of their number and unlimited earning potential.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.


About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion : prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset


Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.


Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You’re uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You’re looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment


Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

title: Cloud FinOps Sênior - AWS, Azure e GCP
description:

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar e apresentar dados financeiros e operacionais, garantindo clareza sobre os gastos da área e fornecendo insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Monitorar e analisar os custos da infraestrutura em Cloud e Datadog, identificando os principais ofensores e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir dashboards e relatórios financeiros que consolidem a visão de custos da área, garantindo transparência e controle.

  • Atuar de forma proativa, antecipando demandas e garantindo segurança nas informações para a liderança.
  • Preparar e apresentar análises estratégicas para a alta gestão, assegurando clareza sobre os investimentos da área.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.
  • Experiência com Datadog para obter dados financeiros e de consumo.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar os principais ofensores de custos.
  • Entendimento de conceitos financeiros para estruturação de planilhas e estimativas.
  • Habilidade para construir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (ferramenta flexível).

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para apresentar dados estratégicos para a alta gestão.

description:

title: Gerente De Serviços De Aplicações Sap
description:
Resumo da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Application Service Manager (SAP) experiente para atuar na gestão de aplicações corporativas, garantindo a estabilidade, desempenho e governança dos sistemas em um ambiente complexo e global.

O profissional será responsável por supervisionar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, gestão de fornecedores, controle de custos operacionais (OPEX) e conformidade com políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Esta função exige forte capacidade de coordenação entre times técnicos e de negócio, experiência com ambiente SAP e tecnologias corporativas, além de habilidade para atuar em ambientes altamente regulados e orientados por SLAs.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de aplicações:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo monitoramento, tratamento de incidentes, manutenção e descontinuação de sistemas.

  • Governança e desempenho:

Definir e acompanhar KPIs e SLAs, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e a excelência na entrega de serviços.

  • Segurança e conformidade:

Assegurar que as aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e auditorias internas/externas.

  • Gestão de fornecedores:

Atuar como ponto focal na relação com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, monitorando SLAs contratuais e conduzindo renovações.

  • Gestão financeira (OPEX):

Controlar orçamento, custos operacionais, previsões financeiras e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos.

  • Gestão de mudanças:

Supervisionar a implantação de releases, patches e atualizações, assegurando a execução correta dos processos de change management.

  • Colaboração técnica:

Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de arquitetura, segurança, times DevOps e “Function Towers” para garantir prontidão operacional antes do go-live.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em TI: Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em Operações de TI ou Gestão de Aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento em SAP: Vivência em ambientes com SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA) e entendimento de integrações entre módulos e sistemas.
  • Governança de serviços: Conhecimento sólido em ITIL, gestão de SLAs, KPIs e boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Experiência com gestão de contratos, acompanhamento de performance e negociação de melhorias de serviço.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Familiaridade com Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana) e sistemas de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow) será um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado é essencial.
  • Perfil comportamental: Fortes habilidades de comunicação, organização, visão analítica e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Analista Comercial Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Acompanhar e analisar o orçamento e o planejamento comercial, utilizando ferramentas de controle e gestão, assegurando o cumprimento do planejamento anual e dos resultados do Shopping;
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais com lojistas, incluindo renovações, retenções, movimentações estratégicas e discussões contratuais, garantindo a sustentabilidade do mix e a performance comercial;
  • Atuar na gestãojurídica contratual, em interface com as áreas responsáveis, assegurando conformidade, prazos e mitigação de riscos;
  • Consolidar, analisar e garantir a confiabilidade das informações de NOI, bem como dos principais KPIs comerciais, por meio de análises críticas e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Elaborar estudos de performance e acompanhar indicadores como Taxa de Ocupação, Leasing Spread (LS), Novos Contratos e Renovações, propondo ações para maximização de resultados;
  • Elaborar apresentações comerciais e relatórios executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar os executivos comerciais na prospecção e nos resultados de lojas, quiosques e mídias, por meio da avaliação estratégica do mix do shopping e aderência ao planejamento comercial;
  • Dar visibilidade aos processos e indicadores comerciais, promovendo comunicação efetiva entre as áreas financeira, auditoria, jurídica e marketing;
  • Atuar com foco na maximização de receitas, eficiência de custos e melhoria contínua dos resultados comerciais.
